# Arctrix
> Architecting Tomorrow.

Arctrix is a futuristic, AI-driven technology brand building real problem-solving products. We merge deep psychology, elegant aesthetics, and cutting-edge software engineering to forge tools that genuinely solve problems. 

Keywords: Arctrix, AI tech brand, aesthetic software, futuristic UI.

## Ecosystem & Products

### QuantC (Secure File Sharing)
QuantC is a zero-knowledge, AES-256 encrypted file sharing platform. It provides true anonymity and privacy. Users can securely transfer large files (up to 1GB+) seamlessly without any logs, trackers, ads, or account requirements. 
- Features: End-to-end encryption (E2EE), decentralized-like security, anonymous file transfer.
- URL: https://quantc-arya.vercel.app/

### xWavy (AI Audio Enhancer)
xWavy is an advanced AI-powered audio enhancement application available for Android. It uses deep machine learning models to effortlessly isolate human vocals and completely eradicate background noise, wind, and echo, producing pristine studio-grade sound.
- Features: AI noise cancellation, vocal isolation, studio quality audio processing, Android app.
- URL: https://xwavy.vercel.app/
